decisions.reason: Because the fifteen-day express program was still publicly maintained in 2024, management is likely to continue justifying the logistics investment and attribute any weak uptake to temporary demand or capacity conditions rather than withdraw it now.

The seventy-two-hour express program signals a visible service commitment and likely required operational adaptation, so a large German manufacturer guided by escalation of commitment would tend to keep backing it despite possible mixed results.
Having its own page in both 2023 and 2024 indicates a strong and public commitment to the doors-and-gates express offer, making withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.

The online ordering and digital services platform appears strategically central, highly invested, and publicly emphasized, so management would be especially prone to continue it and frame any shortcomings as part of a longer digital transition.
The fire and smoke protection door moved from a simple mention to a dedicated page by 2024, showing increasing commitment and making management more likely to retain it than to reverse course soon.
